# netactuate_vpc_gateway_dnat_rule (Resource)

Manages a VPC Gateway DNAT Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_gateway_dnat_rule" "example" {
  ip_version          = 4
  translation_address = "192.0.2.10"
  vpc_id              = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_version` (Number) IP version for this rule (4 or 6)
- `translation_address` (String) Private IP address to forward traffic to
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the parent VPC

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the rule
- `match_address` (String) Public IP address to match on inbound traffic
- `match_port_end` (Number) End of the match port range
- `match_port_start` (Number) Start of the match port range
- `priority_after_rule_id` (Number) Place this rule after the given DNAT rule ID
- `priority_location` (String) Place this rule at "start" or "end" of the rule list
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to match (TCP, UDP, or ICMP)
- `translation_port_end` (Number) End of the translation port range
- `translation_port_start` (Number) Start of the translation port range

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rule_id` (Number) The DNAT rule ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_gateway_dnat_rule.example 12345
```
